name: tech-prediction-fifteen-validation-20261021
notes: ADR-0275 VALIDATION document on the next-session label: fifteen methods on the vol-scaled label (term curve, leg Z, vendor-delta smile, vendor-versus-parity basis, near-money convexity, strike-by-expiry gamma profile, flow, carry, Cboe single-stock indices, market regime, pooled-on-scaled across the fifteen-name cohort, its blend, a two-stage residual model) against mean, the frozen lagged model and the ADR-0274 scaled model. Scores 2021-2025 once with the knobs frozen in prediction-fifteen-selection.json; family per cell: fifteen methods versus scaled (DM) plus every model versus mean, BH 5%. No trade rule, P&L or edge claim.

calendar.notes: Pins the calendar the folds copy.

surface.notes: The three-name 30-DTE surface every prior study used.

surface_universe.notes: Fifteen-name 30-DTE surface (phase-one names plus the twelve cohort roots).

surface_curve.notes: 14/30/60/90-DTE surfaces with term slope and straddle ratio.

positioning_profile.notes: Vendor-Greek positioning with the strike-by-expiry profile, flow and size totals.

positioning_near.notes: Near-the-money (5% band) OI-weighted vega, vanna, vomma, gamma.

delta_surface.notes: Vendor IV at 10/25/40/50 vendor delta, vega-weighted IV and carry at the 30-DTE expiry.

cboe.notes: Onboarded Cboe daily index closes (VIX, VXN, VXAPL, VXAZN, VXGOG, ...), read at the pinned acquisition vintage 2026-10-20T19:50:52Z so a later pull cannot change the run.

vx_rows.notes: Cboe's single-stock 30-day vol indices for the three names.

vx_root.notes: Map each index to its underlying root; an unmapped symbol refuses.

panel_vx.notes: VX index pair difference, its prior-60 Z and 5-session change (method 11).

key_vix.notes: VIX close per date, the alignment key for the other index.

key_vxn.notes: VXN close per date, the alignment key for the other index.

vix_aligned.notes: Keep only the dates on which VXN also printed: Cboe publishes VIX on some US holidays when VXN and the option market are closed, and a hole would void the prior-only window for 60 sessions (ADR-0275 Amendment 2).

vxn_aligned.notes: Keep only the dates on which VIX also printed: Cboe publishes VIX on some US holidays when VXN and the option market are closed, and a hole would void the prior-only window for 60 sessions (ADR-0275 Amendment 2).

mkt_rows.notes: The two aligned index series as one panel.

panel_mkt.notes: log VIX minus log VXN, each leg's prior-60 Z, the 5-session change (method 12).

mkt_fields.notes: Tech premium log VXN - log VIX, its 5-session change, and each index's 60-session Z.

key_mk_prem.notes: One value per date for the join.

key_mk_chg.notes: One value per date for the join.

key_mk_vixz.notes: One value per date for the join.

key_mk_vxnz.notes: One value per date for the join.

delta_sym.notes: Vendor 50-delta level, 25-delta risk reversal, put-wing slope and 10-vs-40 curvature per symbol-day; a missing delta point leaves None.

panel_delta.notes: pair differences of the vendor smile measures, the vega-weighted vendor IV and carry; prior-60 Z (methods 5, 6, 10)

prof_sym.notes: Front (1-30 day) gamma within 2.5% of spot over all gamma, below-minus-above-spot front gamma over all gamma, log volume/OI turnover, log trade count, quoted size imbalance over total size, log front OTM-put over OTM-call volume; a zero denominator leaves None, counted.

panel_prof.notes: pair differences and 5-session changes of the profile and flow measures (methods 8, 9)

near_sym.notes: Near-the-money OI vanna net and OI vomma per unit OI vega.

panel_near.notes: pair differences and prior-60 Z of the convexity ratios (method 7)

panel_c30.notes: 30-DTE ATM IV, log straddle ratio (with its 5-session change) and 30->90 term slope

panel_surf.notes: prior-only 60-session sd of each target spread (the scaling denominator, as ADR-0274) and each leg's 60-session Z (method 2)

panel_u.notes: prior-only 60-session sd of each cohort pair's spread
